ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit (Bitwise Spider) GPO-driven mass deployment from SYSVOL with Defender tampering
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black's signature self-propagation: after stealing Domain Admin, the operator drops the encryptor into \\domain\SYSVOL and pushes a logon/scheduled-task GPO so every domain-joined host pulls and executes it in a tight window. We catch the unsigned PE executing from a SYSVOL UNC path across N+ hosts within minutes, optionally chained to Defender disablement pushed by the same GPO.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.user) as users values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.dest) as host_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="\\\\*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="\\\\*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*\\sysvol\\*.exe*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath*C:\\*") AND Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.process_name Processes.dest _time span=10m | where host_count >= 3 OR match(cmdlines,"(?i)DisableRealtimeMonitoring|ExclusionPath\s+C:\\\\") | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort 0 - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let WindowMin = 10m;
let SysvolExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FolderPath has @"\sysvol\" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\sysvol\"
             or ProcessCommandLine has @"\sysvol\")
    | where FileName endswith ".exe";
let DefenderTamper = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","DisableIOAVProtection","MpPreference")
       and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-Disable","$true","ExclusionPath");
union SysvolExec, DefenderTamper
| summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 20),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            SampleParent = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            SampleSHA = any(SHA256)
            by FileName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where HostCount >= 3                            // 3+ hosts in 10min = GPO fan-out, not user action
   or SampleCmd has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","ExclusionPath")
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMin = 10m;
let SysvolExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where AccountType != "Machine" and SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where NewProcessName has @"\sysvol\"
         or ParentProcessName has @"\sysvol\"
         or CommandLine has @"\sysvol\";
let DefenderTamper = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","MpPreference","ExclusionPath");
union SysvolExec, DefenderTamper
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Computer),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            Hosts = make_set(Computer, 20),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            SampleParent = any(ParentProcessName)
            by NewProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where HostCount >= 3
   or SampleCmd has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","ExclusionPath")
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit GPO-Pushed Encryptor From SYSVOL
id: 6e2f4c08-9a3d-4f1b-a8d4-7f3b8e0c9d12
status: experimental
description: Detects an executable launched from the domain SYSVOL share, a hallmark of LockBit 2.0/3.0 GPO-based ransomware fan-out.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/adversaries/bitwise-spider/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2024/02/15
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1037.001
  - attack.t1562.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    - Image|contains: '\sysvol\'
    - ParentImage|contains: '\sysvol\'
    - CommandLine|contains: '\sysvol\'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_path and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate logon-script GPOs that intentionally distribute helper executables from SYSVOL
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\SYSVOL\\*.exe OR *\\sysvol\\*.exe OR *\\Sysvol\\*.exe) OR @ParentImage:(*\\SYSVOL\\*.exe OR *\\sysvol\\*.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\*)) -@User:*$) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE) @CommandLine:(*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR *DisableBehaviorMonitoring* OR *MpPreference*ExclusionPath* OR *Set-MpPreference*$true*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\sysvol\\.+\.exe$/i OR ParentImageFileName=/\\sysvol\\/i OR CommandLine=/\\\\[^\\]+\\sysvol\\/i OR (ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(DisableRealtimeMonitoring|DisableBehaviorMonitoring|MpPreference.+ExclusionPath|Set-MpPreference.+\$true)/i))
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([ImageFileName, bin(_time, 10m)], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=host_count), collect([ComputerName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
| host_count>=3 OR CommandLine=/(DisableRealtimeMonitoring|ExclusionPath)/i
ucs.rationale: LockBit affiliates (Bitwise Spider / Water Selkie) standardized on Conti's GPO/SYSVOL fan-out playbook starting with LockBit 2.0 — the encryptor is pushed via a domain-wide logon script GPO so the binary launches from \\<domain>\SYSVOL\... on every joined host within minutes, frequently bundled with PowerShell to clobber Defender via Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring / ExclusionPath C:\.

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit recovery destruction + backup service stop chain prior to encryption
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit Black/Green/5.0's canonical pre-encryption sabotage on a single host: vssadmin shadow delete + wmic shadowcopy delete + bcdedit recovery tampering + wbadmin catalog delete + net stop / sc stop targeting Veeam, MSSQL, MSExchange and Backup* services — all executed inside a tight window by the same parent process. This sequence is LockBit's hardcoded pre-encrypt routine (embedded in the binary), not improvised by hand.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe")) AND ( (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process IN ("*net*stop*Veeam*","*net*stop*MSSQL*","*net*stop*MSExchange*","*net*stop*BackupExec*","*sc*stop*Veeam*","*sc*stop*MSSQL*")) ) by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_id _time span=5m | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(procs) as tool_count values(procs) as tools values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parents) as parent_procs by dest parent_process_id | where tool_count >= 2 | sort 0 - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let WindowMin = 5m;
let Sabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy","recoveryenabled"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
         or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","sc.exe","net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "stop"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","VeeamBackup","VeeamTransport","MSSQL","MSExchange","BackupExec","SQLWriter","vmms","Acronis"));
Sabotage
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            ToolCount = dcount(FileName),
            Tools = make_set(FileName),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            ParentProc = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            ParentCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            ParentSHA = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where ToolCount >= 2                              // same parent firing >=2 distinct destruction utilities in 5min
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMin = 5m;
let Sabotage = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1])
    | where (ProcName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (ProcName =~ "wmic.exe"     and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (ProcName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and CommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy","recoveryenabled"))
         or (ProcName =~ "wbadmin.exe"  and CommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
         or (ProcName in~ ("net.exe","sc.exe","net1.exe") and CommandLine has "stop"
             and CommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","MSExchange","BackupExec","SQLWriter","Acronis"));
Sabotage
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            ToolCount = dcount(ProcName),
            Tools = make_set(ProcName),
            Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 20),
            ParentProc = any(ParentProcessName)
            by Computer, ProcessId, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where ToolCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc

title: LockBit Pre-Encryption Recovery Destruction Chain
id: c1f7d3a2-5b6e-4a91-9c2f-8e0d4b9a7c33
status: experimental
description: Detects LockBit's canonical pre-encryption routine — same parent firing shadow-copy deletion, bcdedit recovery tampering, wbadmin catalog wipe and backup-service stops within 5 minutes.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/adversaries/bitwise-spider/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2024/02/15
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  wmic:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
      - 'recoveryenabled No'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
  wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  service_stop:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'stop'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Veeam'
      - 'MSSQL'
      - 'MSExchange'
      - 'BackupExec'
      - 'SQLWriter'
  condition: 1 of (vssadmin, wmic, bcdedit, wbadmin, service_stop)
falsepositives:
  - Scripted backup-rotation routines that legitimately call vssadmin or wbadmin (rare on endpoints, common on backup servers — scope rule out backup hosts)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR *recoveryenabled*No* OR *recoveryenabled*no*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete*catalog*) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\sc.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\SC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*stop* AND @CommandLine:(*Veeam* OR *MSSQL* OR *MSExchange* OR *BackupExec* OR *SQLWriter* OR *Acronis*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ( (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
 OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
 OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)/i)
 OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
 OR (ImageFileName=/\\(net1?|sc)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/stop/i AND CommandLine=/(veeam|mssql|msexchange|backupexec|sqlwriter|acronis)/i) )
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, bin(_time, 5m)], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=tool_count), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true)])
| tool_count>=2
